arabic_text: وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلَيْهِ أَمْتَعَ رَحَمَاتِكَ.
transliteration: wa tarahham `alayhi amt`a rahmatika
english_text: and have mercy upon him with the most enjoyable of Thy mercies!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، صَلاَةً زَاكِيَةً، لاَ تَكُونُ صَلاَةٌ أَزْكَى مِنْهَا،
transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa-ālih, ṣalātan zākiyatān lā takūnu ṣalātun azkā minhā
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a fruitful blessing, more fruitful than which there is no blessing!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً نَامِيَةً، لاَ تَكُونُ صَلاةٌ أَنْمَى مِنْهَا،
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalayhi ṣalātan nāmiyatān lā takūnu ṣalātun ʾanmā minhā
english_text: Bless him with a growing blessing, more growing than which there is no blessing!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاةً رَاضِيَةً، لاَ تَكُونُ صَلاةٌ فَوْقَهَا.
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalayhi ṣalātan rāḍiyatan lā takūnu ṣalātun fawqahā
english_text: And bless him with a pleasing blessing, beyond which there is no blessing!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، صَلاَةً تُرْضِيهِ وَتَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاهُ،
transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan turḍīhi wa tazīdu ʿalā riḍāh
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will please him and increase his good pleasure!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاكَ لَهُ،
transliteration: wa salli ʿalayhi ṣalātan turḍīka wa tazīdu ʿalā riḍāka lah
english_text: Bless him with a blessing which will please Thee and increase Thy good pleasure toward him!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً لاَ تَرْضَى لَهُ إلاَّ بِهَا، وَلاَ تَرى غَيْرَهُ لَهَا أَهْلاً.
transliteration: wa ṣallī ʿalayhi ṣalātan lā tardhā lahū ʾillā bihā wa lā tará ghayrahá lahā áhlān
english_text: And bless him with a blessing through other than which Thou wilt not be pleased for him, and for which Thou seest no one else worthy!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، صَلاَةً تُجَاوِزُ رِضْوَانَكَ، وَيَتَّصِلُ اتِّصَالُهَا بِبَقَآئِكَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَدُ كَمَا لاَ تَنْفَدُ كَلِماتُكَ.
transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan tujāwizu riḍwānaka, wayattasilu attiṣāluhā bibaqā'ika wala yanfadu kama la tanfadu kalimatuka
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will pass beyond Thy good pleasure, be continuous in its continuity through Thy subsistence, and never be spent, just as Thy words will never be spent!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً تَنْتَظِمُ صَلَوَاتِ مَلائِكَتِكَ وَأَنْبِيآئِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ.
transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ālihi ṣalātan tantaziimu ṣalawāti malā'ikatika wa anbiyā'ika wa rusulika wa ahl ṭāʿatika
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will tie together the blessings of Thy angels, Thy prophets, Thy messengers, and those who obey Thee,

arabic_text: وَتَشْتَمِلُ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِ عِبَادِكَ مِنْ جِنّكَ وَإنْسِكَ وَأَهْلِ إجَابَتِكَ، وَتَجْتَمِعُ عَلَى صَلاَةِ كُلِّ مَنْ ذَرَأْتَ وَبَرَأْتَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ خَلْقِكَ.
transliteration: wa tash tamilu ʿala ṣalawāti ʿibādika min jinnika wa'insika wa'ahl ijabatika wa tajtamiʿu ʿala ṣalāti kulli man dharaʾt wa barāʾta min asnāfi khalqik
english_text: comprise the blessings of Thy servants, jinn or mankind, and those worthy of Thy response, and bring together the blessings of every one of the kinds of Thy creatures which Thou hast sown and authored!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً تُحِيطُ بِكُلِّ صَلاَة سَالِفَة وَمُسْتَأْنَفَة،
transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ālihi ṣalātan tuḥīṭu bikulli ṣalātin sālifatin wa mustaʾnafah
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will encompass every blessing, bygone and new!

arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلاَةً مَرْضِيَّةً لَكَ وَلِمَنْ دُونَكَ، وَتُنْشِئُ مَعَ ذَلِكَ صَلَوَات تُضَاعِفُ مَعَهَا تِلْكَ الصَّلَوَاتِ عِنْدَهَا، وَتَزِيدُهَا عَلَى كُرُورِ الاَيَّامِ زِيَادَةً
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihī ṣalātan marḍiyyatan laka wa liman doonaka wa tunshi'u ma'a dhalika salawat tudha'ifu ma'aha tilka as-salawat 'indaha wa tazīduhā ʿalā kurūri al-ayyām ziyādah
english_text: Bless him and his Household with a blessing which is pleasing to Thee and everyone below Thee and will bring forth with all that a blessing with which Thou wilt multiply those blessings and increase them through the recurrence of days with an increasing

arabic_text: فِي تَضَاعِيفَ لاَ يَعُدُّهَا غَيْرُكَ.
transliteration: fi taḍāʿīf lā yaʿudduhā ghayruka
english_text: in multiples which none can count but Thou!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى أَطَائِبِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَرْتَهُمْ لاَِمْرِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ خَزَنَةَ عِلْمِكَ، وَحَفَظَةَ دِيْنِكَ، وَخُلَفَآءَكَ فِي أَرْضِكَ، وَحُجَجَكَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ،
transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā aṭ-ṭā’ibī ahl baytih al-ladhīna akhtartahum lāmirka wajaʿaltahu khazanata ʿil mika wa ḥafaza tadiynik wa khulafāʾaka fī arḍika, wa ḥujajaka ʿalā ʿibādika
english_text: My Lord, bless the best of his Household, those whom Thou hast chosen for Thy command, appointed the treasurers of Thy knowledge, the guardians of Thy religion, Thy vicegerents in Thy earth, and Thy arguments against Thy servants,

arabic_text: وَطَهَّرْتَهُمْ مِنَ الرِّجْسِ وَالدَّنَسِ تَطْهِيراً بِإرَادَتِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيْلَةَ إلَيْكَ وَالْمَسْلَكَ إلَى جَنَّتِكَ،
transliteration: waṭahharthum mina alrijsi wa aldanas tathhiran biiradatika wa jaʿaltahumu al-wasīlata ilayka wal-maslaka ila jannatika
english_text: purified from uncleanness and defilement through a purification by Thy desire (ref:33:33), and made the mediation to Thee and the road to Thy Garden!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاةً تُجْزِلُ لَهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ نِحَلِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ، وَتُكْمِلُ لَهُمُ الاَشْيَآءَ مِنْ عَطَاياكَ وَنَوَافِلِكَ، وَتُوَفِّرُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَظَّ مِنْ عَوَائِدِكَ وَفَوائِدِكَ.
transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan tuǧzilu lahum bihā min niḥalika wa karāmatika wa tukmilu lahumul-ashya'a min 'ataayika wanawafiliki wa tuwaffiru ʿalayhimu al-ḥazza min ʿawāʾidika wa fawāʾidika
english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which makes plentiful Thy gifts and generosity, perfects for them Thy bestowals and awards, and fills out their share of Thy kindly acts and benefits!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً لاَ أَمَدَ فِي أَوَّلِهَا، وَلاَ غَايَةَ لاَِمَدِهَا، وَلاَ نِهَايَةَ لاِخِرِهَا.
transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim ṣalātan lā amada fī awalihā walā ghāyata lā madīhā, walā nihāyata li-akhirihā
english_text: My Lord, bless him and his Household with a blessing whose first has no term, whose term has no limit, and whose last has no utmost end!

arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَا دُونَهُ، وَمِلءَ سَموَاتِكَ وَمَا فَوْقَهُنَّ، وَعَدَدَ أَرَضِيْكَ، وَمَا تَحْتَهُنَّ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ، صَلاَةً تُقَرِّبُهُمْ مِنْكَ زُلْفى وَتَكُونُ لَكَ وَلَهُمْ رِضَىً،
transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhim zinata ʿarshika wa mā dūnah wa mil'a samawātika wa mā fawqahunna waʿadada arḍīka, wa mā taḥtahunna, wa mā baynahunna ṣalātan tuqarribuhum minka zulfa wa takūnu laka wa lahum riḍān
english_text: My Lord, bless them to the weight of Thy Throne and all below it, the amount that fills the heavens and all above them, the number of Thy earths and all below and between them, a blessing that will bring them near to Thee in proximity, please Thee and them,

arabic_text: وَمُتَّصِلَةٌ بِنَظَائِرِهِنَّ أَبَداً.
transliteration: wa muttaṣilatun bi-naẓāʾirihinna abadan
english_text: and be joined to its likes forever!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَيَّدْتَ دِينَكَ فِي كُلِّ أَوَان بِإمَام أَقَمْتَهُ عَلَماً لِعِبَادِكَ وَّمَنارَاً فِي بِلاَدِكَ، بَعْدَ أَنْ وَصَلْتَ حَبْلَهُ بِحَبْلِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka ayyadta dīnaka fī kulli awān bi'imām aqamtahu 'ilman li'ibādik wa manāran fī bilādik baʿda an waṣal-ta ḥabl-ahu bi-ḥabl-ika
english_text: O God, surely Thou hast confirmed Thy religion in all times with an Imam whom Thou hast set up as a guidepost to Thy servants and a lighthouse in Thy lands, after his cord has been joined to Thy cord!

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتَهُ الذَّرِيعَةَ إلَى رِضْوَانِكَ، وَافْتَرَضْتَ طَاعَتَهُ، وَحَذَّرْتَ مَعْصِيَتَهُ، وَأَمَرْتَ بِامْتِثَالِ أوَاِمِرِه وَالانْتِهَآءِ عِنْدَ نَهْيِهِ، وَأَلاَّ يَتَقَدَّمَهُ مُتَقَدِّمٌ، وَلاَ يَتَأَخَّرَ عَنْهُ مُتَأَخِّرٌ،فَهُوَ عِصْمَةُ اللاَّئِذِينَ
transliteration: wajaʿaltahu al-dḥariʿah illá riḍwānika wa 'if'taradta ṭāʿatahu, wa ḥaẓẓarta maʿṣīyatuhu wa'amarta bimtithali awamirihi wal-intihai'i 'inda nahyihi wa alā yataqaddama-hu mutaqaddimun, wa lā yataʾakhkhar ʿan-hu mutaʾakhkhirun, fahuwa ʿismatu l
english_text: Thou hast appointed him the means to Thy good pleasure, made obeying him obligatory, cautioned against disobeying him, and commanded following his commands, abandoning what he has prohibited, and that no forward-goer go ahead of him or back-keeper keep back from him! So he is the preservation of the shelter-seekers,

arabic_text: ، وَكَهْفُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَعُرْوَةُ الْمُتَمَسِّكِينَ، وَبَهَآءُ الْعَالَمِينَ.
transliteration: wa kahfu al-mu'minīn, wa ʿurwat al-mutamassikīn, wa bahāʾu al-ʿālamīn
english_text: the cave of the faithful, the handhold of the adherents, and the radiance of the worlds!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَأَوْزِعْ لِوَلِيِّكَ شُكْرَ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَوْزِعْنَا مِثْلَهُ فِيهِ، وَآتِهِ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَاناً نَصِيراً، وَافْتَحْ لَهُ فَتْحاً يَسِيراً، وَأَعِنْهُ بِرُكْنِكَ الاعَزِّ، وَاشْدُدْ أَزْرَهُ، وَقَوِّ عَضُدَهُ، وَرَاعِهِ بِعَيْنِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma fa'awzil liwaliyyika shukra mā an`amta bihī `alayhi wa ʾawziʿnā mithlahu fīh, wa ʾātihī min ladunka sulṭānan naṣīran waftaḥ lahū fatḥan yasīran wa-aʿin-hu bi-ruknikal aʿazz wa ashuddu azrah, wa qawwia 'adudah, wa ra'ihi bi'aynik
english_text: O God, so inspire Thy guardian to give thanks for that in which Thou hast favoured him, inspire us with the like concerning him, grant him 'an authority from Thee to help him' (ref.17:80), open for him an easy opening, aid him with Thy mightiest pillar, brace up his back, strengthen his arm, guard him with Thy eye,

arabic_text: وَاحْمِهِ بِحِفْظِكَ، وَانْصُرْهُ بِمَلائِكَتِكَ، وَامْدُدْهُ بِجُنْدِكَ الاَغْلَبِ وَأَقِمْ بِهِ كِتَابَكَ وَحُدُودَكَ، وَشَرَائِعَكَ وَسُنَنَ رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، وَأَحْيِ بِهِ مَا أَمَاتَهُ الظَّالِمُونَ مِنْ مَعَالِمِ دِينِكَ،
transliteration: wa'aḥmih biḥifẓika, waansurhu bimala'ikatika wa-amdudhu bi-jundika al-aǧlabi wa-aqim bihi kitabaka wa-ḥududaka wa sharāʾiʿaka wa sunan rasūlika ṣalawātuka allāhumma ʿalayhi wa ālihi wa aḥyi bihi mā amātahu aẓ-ẓālimūna min maʿālimi dīnika
english_text: defend him with Thy safeguarding, help him with Thy angels, and assist him with Thy most victorious troops! Through him establish Thy Book, Thy bounds, Thy laws, and the norms of Thy Messenger's Sunna (Thy blessings, O God, be upon him and his Household), bring to life the guideposts of Thy religion, deadened by the wrongdoers,

arabic_text: وَاجْلُ بِهِ صَدَآءَ الْجَوْرِ عَنْ طَرِيقَتِكَ، وَأَبِنْ بِهِ الضَّرَّآءَ مِنْ سَبِيلِكَ، وَأَزِلْ بِهِ النَّاكِبِينَ عَنْ صِرَاطِكَ، وَامْحَقْ بِهِ بُغَاةَ قَصْدِكَ عِوَجاً،
transliteration: waajlu bihi sadaa' al-jawri 'an tariqatika wa ʾabini bihi aḍ-ḍarrrā'a min sabīlika wa azil bihi annākibīna 'an ṣirātika wamḥaq bihi bughātat qaṣdika ʿiwajā
english_text: burnish the rust of injustice from Thy way, sift the adversity from Thy road, eliminate those who deviate from Thy path, and erase those who seek crookedness in Thy straightness!

arabic_text: وَأَلِنْ جَانِبَهُ لاَِوْلِيَآئِكَ، وَابْسُطْ يَدَهُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِكَ، وَهَبْ لَنا رَأْفَتَهُ وَرَحْمَتَهُ وَتَعَطُّفَهُ وَتَحَنُّنَهُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُ سَامِعِينَ مُطِيعِينَ، وَفِي رِضَاهُ سَاعِينَ، وَإلَى نُصْرَتِهِ وَالْمُدَافَعَةِ عَنْهُ مُكْنِفِينَ،
transliteration: wa 'alin janibahu li-awliyā'ika, wa 'absut yadahu 'ala 'a'dā'ika wahab lana ra'fatahu wa rahmatahu wa ta'attufahu wa tahannunahu wa-jaʿalna lahu sāmiʿīna muṭīʿīna, wa fī riḍāhu sāʿīna wa-ilā nuṣratihī wal-mudāfaʿah ʿanhū muknifīn
english_text: Make his side mild toward Thy friends, stretch forth his hand over Thy enemies, give us his clemency, his mercy, his tenderness, his sympathy, and make us his hearers and obeyers, strivers toward his good pleasure, assistants in helping him and defending him,

arabic_text: وَإلَيْكَ وَإلَى رَسُولِكَ صَلَواتُكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِذَلِكَ مُتَقَرِّبِينَ.
transliteration: wa-ilayka wa-ilaa rasulika ṣalawaatuka allāhumma ʿalayhi wa ālihi bidhālika mutaqarrabīna.
english_text: and brought near through that to Thee and Thy Messenger (Thy blessings, O God, be upon him and his Household).

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى أَوْلِيآئِهِمُ الْمُعْتَرِفِينَ بِمَقَامِهِمْ، الْمُتَّبِعِينَ مَنْهَجَهُمْ، الْمُقْتَفِيْنَ آثَارَهُمْ، الْمُسْتَمْسِكِينَ بِعُرْوَتِهِمْ، الْمُتَمَسِّكِينَ بِوَلاَيَتِهِمْ، الْمُؤْتَمِّينَ بِإمَامَتِهِمْ، الْمُسَلِّمِينَ لاَِمْرِهِمْ
transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā awliyāʾihimu al-muʿtarifīna bimaqāmihim al-mutta bi'īna manhajahum, al-muqtāfiīna āthārahum al-mustamisikiina bi-ʿurwatihim, al-mutamassikiina bi-walayatihim al-muʾtamminan bi-imāmatihim, al-muslimīn lā ʾamrihim
english_text: O God, and bless the friends [of the Imams], the confessors of their station, the keepers to their course, the pursuers of their tracks, the clingers to their handhold, the adherents to their guardianship, the followers of their imamate, the submitters to their command,

arabic_text: الْمُجْتَهِدِيْنَ فِي طاعَتِهِمْ، الْمُنْتَظِرِيْنَ أَيَّامَهُمْ، الْمَادِّينَ إلَيْهِمْ أَعْيُنَهُمْ، الصَّلَوَاتِ الْمُبَارَكَاتِ الزَّاكِيَاتِ النَّامِيَاتِ الغَادِيَاتِ، الرَّائِحاتِ.
transliteration: al-mujtahidīna fī ṭāʿatihim, al-muntazirīna ayyāmahum al-māddīnah ilayhim aʿyunahum al-ṣalawāt al-mubārakāt al-zākiyāt al-nāmiyāt al-ghādiyāt, al-rā'iḥāt
english_text: the strivers to obey them, the awaiters of their days, the directors of their eyes toward them, with blessings blessed, pure, growing, fresh, and fragrant!

arabic_text: وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى أَرْوَاحِهِمْ، وَاجْمَعْ عَلَى التَّقْوَى أَمْرَهُمْ، وَأَصْلِحْ لَهُمْ شُؤُونَهُمْ، وَتُبْ عَلَيْهِمْ
transliteration: wa sallim ʿalayhim wa ʿala arwāhihim waajmaʿ ʿalaa altaqwaa amrahum wa asliḥ lahum shuʾūnahum wa tub ʿalayhim
english_text: Give them and their spirits peace, bring together their affair in reverential fear, set right their situations, turn toward them,
